title: Law to let New Yorkers sue over unfair business practices
summary: This bill would create a new city law banning unfair, deceptive, abusive or unlawful business practices and unfair methods of competition in commerce. It would let consumers, workers, nonprofits and small businesses sue violators directly, with damages of at least $2,500 per violation plus attorney's fees. Lawsuits would need to be filed within 3 years and generally require 10 days' notice to the other party before suing, though the city, its agencies and small businesses could not be sued under this law.
